title: AutoISF in androidaps 3.3.2.0-dev does not contain "Activity modifies sensitivity" feature
body:
I started using the AutoISF with latest 3.3.2.0-dev. I noticed the UI does not have the "Activity modifies sensitivity"  menu that is listed in the https://github.com/ga-zelle/autoISF/blob/A3.2.0.4_ai3.0.1/autoISF3.0.1_Quick_Guide.pdf (page 9). 

I think this feature has not been integrated into the AndroidAPS 3.3 codebase.

Questions for @ga-zelle and/or @T-o-b-i-a-s (or other AutoISF devs):
* am I right this feature only exists in [T-o-b-i-a-s/AndroidAPS 3.2.0.4-ai3.0.3-noVersionCheck](https://github.com/T-o-b-i-a-s/AndroidAPS/tree/3.2.0.4-ai3.0.3-noVersionCheck), or is there a 3.3-based branch that has this integrated somewhere?
*  are people still using this "Activity modifies sensitivity" feature, or is it abonded?
* can you share an Discord discussion on AutoISF if that's available? The links I find online are outdated

I would ike to see if I can help merge this feature into a feature AndroidAPS release, but are searching for more information on this feature and who is working on it. I liked the Stepcount Features in https://github.com/tim2000s/Boost_AAPS_3.2 of @tim2000s , but that is also stil 3.2.0.4 based.

comments.body:
Agreed, currently only released based on 3.2.0.4.
However, the good news is that a dedicated, standalone release based on  3.3.3.0 including full AutoISF3.1.0 is in its final test phase. Once ready it will be announced in Discord's  autoisf channel.
Thanks for the info. I will close this issue as AutoISF is not part of the main/master yet.
